searchText: Any idea why is my geth showing `Previously seen beacon client is offline. Please ensure it is operational to follow the chain!` like every 5-10 minutes? Usually it's because geth hasn't received a new payload from consensus in a while. But sometimes geth logs the error even if that's not the case, could be a bug. It's harmless. Last big issue I have in my devnet-v4 docker-compose setup is that whenever I restart prysm, the sync begins from zero again. The volume is persisted though. Any idea? code is here https://github.com/PabloCastellano/devnet-v4 do you have `--force-clear-db` flag enabled in prysm? oh yes 😅 I blindly copied it from the k8s config 🙂 yeah that flag is the cause Is it in the k8s config for any particular reason? which k8s config are you referring to? https://github.com/ethpandaops/4844-testnet/blob/master/kubernetes/devnet-4/node-001/values.yaml (oh, the flag was removed yesterday) Yeah I removed it yesterday, sorry! It was there for debugging reasons initially 🙏
